counting: New flags are distinct native flag boxes beyond the common prefix. Only complete pairs enter contrasts. Average those pairs within each world, then weight the 3 worlds equally. A win means ownership found more new flags. Arm-only scores do not require a complete pair. Model-invalid arms can have a verified baseline reward but no primary outcome. Proposals and choices use original box numbers in A, B, C order. An initial collision is any duplicate proposal. The first label owns each proposed box.
scope: One native move in 3 fixed historical worlds. No population or cost claim.
